title: The Creepiest Incident In Naval History
hook: In 1947, ships across the Straits of Malacca picked up a chilling Morse code SOS.

scenes.text: In 1947, ships across the Straits of Malacca picked up a chilling Morse code SOS.
scenes.visual_prompt: vintage 1940s naval radio operator listening in dimly lit radio room, static green glow, cinematic dark horror aesthetic, 8k vertical

scenes.text: The message simply read: All officers including captain are dead. I die.
scenes.visual_prompt: vintage typewriter printing eerie morse code on aged parchment, macro shallow depth of field, dramatic dark shadows, 8k vertical

scenes.text: When rescue teams boarded the SS Ourang Medan, they found the entire crew deceased, eyes wide open, staring at the sky.
scenes.visual_prompt: ghost ship floating in silent eerie foggy ocean under moonlight, cold blue mist, chilling cinematic thriller composition, 8k vertical

scenes.text: There was not a single scratch or sign of violence on any body.
scenes.visual_prompt: creepy abandoned ship bridge with wheel spinning slowly in wind, flickering emergency lights, 8k vertical masterpiece

scenes.text: Before investigators could search the lower deck, an unexplained fire forced them off, and the vessel sank forever.
scenes.visual_prompt: burning silhouette of an old cargo ship sinking into stormy dark waves, fiery orange sparks, epic atmospheric lighting, 8k vertical

cta: What do you think killed the crew?
